rules.statement: Dangling and cross-tenant references do not compile; a request that reaches a Broken entry on the data plane fails closed (F4, F5).
The codecs neither encode nor decode Match.Exactly("*"): * only ever means Match.Any.
guards: runtime:PolicyDocumentCodecTest#the wildcard is only ever Any

rules.statement: A document whose schema is not this version's format fails to decode, as does one that is not exactly this format (an unknown field, a second operator, a value of the wrong JSON type), and the requests that need it fail closed.

A path pattern's cost is bounded: an `http:path:` pattern longer than 2,048 characters, or with a segment that mixes `*`, `?` or `{name}` with other text in more than 16 parts (consecutive `*` counting once), does not compile, nor does a document whose patterns hold more than 2,048 glob units in all: the parts and literal characters of such segments, counted twice after a leading `**` or `{*name}` and for a rate limit rule keyed by a captured variable. A typed resource pattern is at most 2,058 characters.
guards: engine:HttpPathPatternTest#a pattern is at most 2048 characters
engine:HttpPathPatternTest#a glob segment holds at most 16 tokens
engine:HttpPathPatternTest#consecutive stars in a segment count once
engine:HttpPathPatternTest#a glob after a leading rest costs twice and is tried at two starts
engine:HttpPathPatternTest#a glob after a leading rest is decided at most twice
engine:CompiledDocumentTest#a document holds at most its glob budget
engine:ActionResourcePatternTest#a typed pattern is at most 2058 characters

rules.statement: Every stored format CoSec reads, and every control-plane request body, refuses an object with a duplicate key: CoSec's one mapper reads them all with duplicate detection, so no value is read as whichever of two came last.
guards: cocache:StoredFormatTest#a duplicate key fails every stored format
control:ControlHttpTest#a body with a duplicate key is refused

rules.statement: A document holds at most 64 rate limit rules, whatever its kind: every rule a permitted request matches costs the pipeline one call to the rate limiter, so a document with more does not compile (a stored one is installed as failed, and the control plane answers a change with a COMPILE finding, 422).
guards: engine:CompiledDocumentTest#a document holds at most its rate limit rules

rules.source: RFC 0006 §8.1; round-2 review M3 of the backends
rules.statement: A rate limit rule's window is at most a day (windowSeconds from 1 to 86400): a counter key lives two windows in a Redis that must not evict, one key per bucket value, so a long window keyed by something a client chooses would be memory the client controls. A document with a longer window does not decode (a stored one is installed as failed, and the control plane refuses a change that makes one), and the schema says the same.
guards: model:DecisionTest#a rate limit spec is bounded

rules.source: RFC 0005 §5.1, RFC 0006 §5.3.1 (round 2 review of host and tools, M2)
rules.statement: An http action no request can have does not compile, in a statement or a rate limit rule: http:HEAD, since a HEAD request is decided as GET (PIP-18), and an http verb holding an ASCII lower-case letter, since a method that holds one is refused before any decision. The message names the action and says to write http:GET, or the verb in upper case. http:*, upper-case verbs and the verbs of other services stay valid. The data plane and the control plane compile with the one compiler, so a stored document with such an action is installed as failed, and the control plane refuses a change that makes one; the schema says the same.
guards: engine:PolicyCompilerTest#an http action no request can have does not compile
